verdict.rationale: A tax agency serving software developers could plausibly publish versioned APIs, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only a portal, a 1099 XML file format that follows IRS IRIS schemas, and a 'For Tax Software Developers' page title. No versioned API or deprecation policy is documented, and all OpenAPI probe paths returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
